reviewMethod: authored-frame visual review; pose landmarks only as draft aids
reviewNotes: Reviewed against authored RIGHT/LEFT contact sheets and high-risk pose groups.
head targets anatomical head/face center for runtime prop attachment, not hair-top.
front/back hand and foot identity is fixed from the facing-relative idle limb and preserved through animation.
foot anchors target visible shoe/foot silhouette near the corresponding pose-estimated ankle; pose-only off-silhouette points are rejected.
